_provenance.description: ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) known-answer vectors copied verbatim from the NIST ACVP-Server gen-val sample files. keyGen tests give the seed halves d and z with the expected encapsulation key ek and decapsulation key dk. encapsulation tests give a NIST-produced ciphertext c and shared secret k for a known dk; they are run here as decapsulation checks because liboqs draws the encapsulation randomness m itself. decapsulation tests include modified ciphertexts whose expected k is the implicit-rejection value. Evidence mapping to NIST sample vectors, not a certification claim.
_provenance.selection: ML-KEM-1024 only: keyGen tgId 3, first five tests; encapsulation tgId 3, first eight tests (dk, c, k); decapsulation tgId 6, all ten tests (valid decapsulation and modified ciphertext). Key-check groups (tgId 11 and 12) are omitted because liboqs exposes no key-check function.
